SEAT RE | status: NEED-MORE
did: T20 partial. Proved the +0x9C layout and where faction actually lives; could NOT enumerate the full hostile (kind,role) set - the IDB lost its function database mid-task (separate BLOCKED report).
evidence: (A) ROLE IS NOT THE HOSTILITY AXIS. Friendly-fire/damage gate sub_133F630 @0x133f630 reads only kind: v9 = *(a2+0x9C) and 7, v10 = (v9==1), v15 = (v9==2); v11 = *(a1+0x9C) and 7; role is never read. kind1 and kind2 are special-cased; everything else is damageable by anything.
(B) Only two (kind,role) pair predicates are proven, both __thiscall with this = ande->dw9C: sub_54EC00 @0x54ec00 = (kind2, role2) civilian, callers 0x199a66a and 0x1aedf88; sub_73B4B0 @0x73b4b0 = (kind3, role1) guard, caller 0x1619a0c where the result picks the perception radius ([esi+0x18] * flt_1E46770). No sibling predicate for Thief(3) or Mercenary(5) was located: UNPROVEN.
(C) bits9-14 = a 6-bit variant set independently of role: sub_4EDCF0 @0x4edcf0 does *this = *this and 0xFFFF8007 | (8 * (a3 and 0x3F | ((a4 and 0x3F) << 6))). Tested at 0x199a1d9 as (v and 0x7E00)==0x600 (variant 3) next to role 23 Naval. It is NOT faction. Semantic meaning: UNPROVEN.
(D) FACTION is a separate object, not inside +0x9C. sub_6F5F70 @0x6f5f70 disasm (0x6f5f70..0x6f5f8c): mov eax,[eax+0E8h]; test; mov eax,[eax+1Ch] = return *(*(entity+0xE8)+0x1C). sub_133A4C0 @0x133a4c0 returns *(char_+0xA4) after a sub_F916A0 handle-validity test; sub_15DF6E0 reads the name at faction+8. Setter: UNPROVEN.
next: restore the IDB function list, then enumerate every (kind,role) predicate and find the writer of char_+0xA4.
